_provenance.needs: one CUDA GPU and Imagenette; these figures are from an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB
_provenance.method: Imagenette, 10 classes, ~9.5k training images. SGD, momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, batch 32, 5 epochs. Images mean-subtracted only, as the paper specifies - no division by standard deviation.
_provenance.note: This is NOT ILSVRC and five epochs is not seventy-four. The result is about which initialisations train at all on a deep rectified network, not about what accuracy VGG reaches.

heatmap.what: Configuration E, validation accuracy after five epochs. Four initialisations against five learning rates. Chance is 10.0%.

summary.reading: Only Kaiming trains configuration E at all, and only at the two lowest rates. Its usable window has two different edges: at 1e-2 the network settles at chance, and from 3e-2 upward it diverges outright.

signal_deficit.what: Modelled shortfall in weight standard deviation against Kaiming, compounded over the number of layers left on the weaker initialisation: D = (sigma_Kaiming / sigma_init)^n.

checked_against_measurement.reading: One of the five bars has been compared with a measurement and the model understates it six-fold. Read the axis as an ordering, not a physical quantity. The threshold band is set by the measured outcomes, not by the model.

signal_deficit.reading: Glorot supplies half Kaiming's variance per layer, so the shortfall compounds as (1/sqrt(2)) raised to the number of layers. Over 8 layers that is survivable; over 16 it is not. The paper's pre-initialisation removes four bad layers, and four is enough.

pre_initialisation.what: The paper's procedure: train configuration A, then initialise the deeper network's first four convolutions and last three fully-connected layers from it.

donor.note: Retraining the same donor three times spread 5.3 points. Any transplant result inside that spread is not a finding.

could_not_be_reproduced.what: The paper trains its donor A with its own random initialisation.
could_not_be_reproduced.why: That initialisation does not train configuration A here either, at any rate tried, so the paper's donor could not be produced. The donor used was Kaiming-trained.
could_not_be_reproduced.consequence: This is a test of whether a trained A rescues E. It is not a test of the paper's method end to end.

post_submission_note.paper_says: Glorot initialisation removes the need for pre-training
post_submission_note.measured: These runs do not support that for configuration E, across five learning rates and five epochs. The authors were writing before Kaiming initialisation existed and before anyone had shown that Glorot fails on deep rectified networks.
